sources.notes: Corroborates selected team efficiencies and conditions.

notes: 243 layout with two gold factories and two battle-record factories.
The exact evaluation window is groups-a-b plus groups-b-c (24 hours); groups-c-a completes the separate 36-hour sustainability cycle.
All explicitly rostered JP-available operators have all base skills unlocked.
Fixed office and dormitory context is normalized-theoretical; identified ordinary remote support remains separate from factory occupants.
Storage stoppage is excluded; the strict ledger explicitly witnesses drone generation, allocation, gold continuity, and every resource field.
Factory compositions and the complete base rotation are backed by Wikiru backup 38; the Phase 1 assumption bundle supplies only the three pinned PR40 domains.
